Friends
1005 - The One Where Rachel's Sister Baby-sits

Written by: Dana Klein
Produced by: Robert Carlock and Wendy Knoller
Transcribed by: Coffee Mug, Eleonora, Sebastiano & Vanessa

[Scene: Central Perk]

 

Rachel: You know, I'm thinking about letting Emma have her first cookie.
你知道，我正在考虑让艾玛吃她的第一块饼干。

Joey: Her first cookie?
她的第一块饼干？ She has cookies all the time!
她一直有饼干！

Rachel: I've never given her a cookie.
我从来没有给过她饼干。 Have you?
你？

Joey: No!
不！ No...
不... and, for the record, I've also never given her a frosting from a can!
而且，郑重声明，我也从未给过她罐装糖霜！

Monica: Hey Rach, the adoption agency needs letters of recommendation and we were wondering if you would write one for us.
嘿，瑞奇，收养机构需要推荐信，我们想知道您是否能为我们写一封推荐信。

Rachel: Of course, I'd be honored!
当然，我会很荣幸！

Chandler: Thanks!
谢谢！

Monica: Thank you!
谢谢你！

(Joey looks at them, disappointed about their decision)

Joey: U-U-Um, I think there's been an oversight.
U-U-Um，我认为这是一个疏忽。

Chandler: Joey, we would've asked you, we just thought you wouldn't be interested.
乔伊，我们本来会问你的，我们只是认为你不会感兴趣。

Monica: Yeah, it's just we don't think of you as really being so much "with the words".
对，我们只是觉得你不太擅长遣词造句。

Joey: Whoo-weh hey weh-hey whoo hey!!
呜呜呜嘿嘿嘿！！

Monica: Clearly we were wrong.
显然我们错了。

Joey: I gotta a lot of nice stuff to say about you guys, ok?
我有很多关于你们的好话要说，好吗？ And I know how much you wanna have a baby, you know, and I would love to help you get one.
我知道你们多想要个孩子，我很乐意帮你们领养一个。

Monica: You know what?
你知道吗？ Then, Joey, we want you to do it.
那么，乔伊，我们希望你这么做。

Joey: Thank you!
谢谢你！ Alright, let me see how I'm gonna start...
好吧，让我看看要如何开始…… "Dear baby adoption decider people..."
“亲爱的婴儿收养决定者……”

Chandler: So excited about your letter!
真期待你写出来的信啊！

(Phoebe enters)

Phoebe: Hey!
嘿！

All: Hey Phoebe!
嘿菲比！

Joey: Hey!
嘿！

Monica: Wow!
哇！ Don't you look nice?!
哇，你今天真漂亮！

Phoebe: Yes, I do!
没错，我是很漂亮！ Today is Mike and my one-year anniversary.
今天是迈克和我的一周年纪念日。

Rachel: OH!
哦！ What's it the anniversary of?
周年纪念日是什么？ Your first date, your first kiss, first time you had sex...
你的第一次约会、你的初吻、第一次做爱……

Phoebe: YEAH!
是的！

Chandler: So you must be going to somewhere fancy to celebrate?
那么你一定要去某个特别的地方庆祝吗？

Phoebe: Uh-uh.
呃呃。 Ehm, a Knicks game.
嗯，一场尼克斯队的比赛。

Joey: Uhm...
嗯…… Aren't you a little overdressed?
你这样穿是不是太隆重了？

Phoebe: Hey, you know what, I've never had a one-year anniversary before, so no matter where we go, I'm wearing something fancy pants, and...
我以前从来没庆祝过恋爱一周年，所以不管去哪儿，我都要盛装打扮，而且…… I'm gonna put on my finest jewelry and we're gonna have sex in a public rest room.
我要戴上最好的首饰，还要在公共厕所里做爱。

Monica: You guys do that?
你们这样做吗？ Chandler won't even have sex in our bathroom!
钱德勒甚至不会在我们的浴室里做爱！

Chandler: That's where people make number two!!
那里可是人家拉大便的地方！


OPENING CREDITS

[Scene: Ross' apartment. Ross is grading papers. Charlie approaches him.]

 

Charlie: Hey!
嘿！ (They kiss and cuddle a little)

Ross: Hey...
嘿...

Charlie: So, you know...
所以，你知道... I have a little time.
我有一点时间。 If you...
如果你... if you want to...
如果你想...

Ross: (surprised) Oh...
（惊讶）噢... (he pauses) (sounds disappointed) Ohh...
（他停顿）（听起来很失望）哦... I'd love to but I really have to grade these papers.
我很愿意，但我真的必须对这些论文进行评分。

Charlie: Fine, it's fine...
还好，还好…… (she whispers) I'll just shower by myself...
（她低声说道）我自己去洗澡……

Ross: (Writing on the papers) B, B, B, B, B!
（写在纸上）B，B，B，B，B！

Charlie: Oh, Ross, you gave a B to a Pottery Barn catalogue.
罗斯，你给了本 Pottery Barn 家具目录一个 B。

Ross: Well, it had some good ideas, take off your shirt.
好吧，它有一些好主意，脱掉你的衬衫。

(they start kissing but someone knocks at the door)

Ross: Damnit!
该死的！

Amy: (yelling from outside) Rachel!!
（外面大喊）瑞秋！ Open up!!
打开！！ It's your sister!!
是你妹妹！！ (she knocks on the door again) I have to talk to you!!
（她再次敲门）我得跟你谈谈！！

Ross: (he opens the door) Hi Amy!
（他打开门）嗨，艾米！

Amy: You're not Rachel.
你不是瑞秋。

Ross: Still sharp as a tack!
还是那么机灵啊！

Amy: Um...
嗯... Charlie, this is Rachel's sister Amy.
查理，这是瑞秋的妹妹艾米。 Amy, this is Charlie.
艾米，这是查理。

Charlie: Hi!
你好！

Amy: Hi!
你好！

Charlie: Nice to meet you.
很高兴见到你。

Amy: H-Hi!!(to Ross) And you are...?
嗨-嗨！！（对罗斯）你是……？

Ross: (pause) Ross?
（停顿）罗斯？ I...
我... I grew up on your block!
我是在你的街区长大的！ We had Thanksgiving together last year...
去年我们一起过感恩节... I had a baby with your sister!
我和你妹妹生了孩子！

Amy: (looks confused) N-no...
（一脸困惑）不、不…… uhm...
嗯…… did I buy a falafel from you yesterday?
我昨天从你那里买了沙拉三明治吗？

Ross: (gives up) Yes, yes, you did.
（放弃）是的，是的，你做到了。

 

[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment]

 

(Ross enters the apartment with Amy)

Ross: Hi Rachel!
嗨，瑞秋！ Here's your sister Amy!
这是你妹妹艾米！ She thinks I need pec implants!
她认为我需要胸肌植入物！

Rachel: Amy!
艾米！ Hi!
你好！ Oh-oh-hoh!
哦哦哦！ (they hug) Wow!
（他们拥抱）哇！ You remember Joey?
你还记得乔伊吗？

Amy: Yeah!
是的！ Hey, sure!
嘿，当然！ The "Days of Our Lives" guy!
“我们的日子”的家伙！

Joey: That's right, yeah.
没错，是的。

Amy: You're not good!
你演得不怎么样！

Joey: Always nice to meet a fan!
见到粉丝总是很高兴！

Rachel: So now, what are you doing here?
那么现在，你在这里做什么？

Amy: Well, I have huge news.
嗯，我有一个重大消息。

Rachel: (Emma starts crying in the other room) Oh sorry, hold on.
（艾玛在另一个房间开始哭泣）哦，抱歉，等等。 Let me just check on the baby!
我先去看看宝宝的情况吧！

Amy: Wait, this is important!
等等，这很重要！ Can Ella wait?
艾拉可以等吗？ (Rachel goes to Emma)

Ross: Ehm...
嗯…… Her name is Emma.
她的名字叫艾玛。

Amy: Why did you change it, Ella was so much prettier!
干吗改名？艾拉这个名字好听多了！

Ross: What do I know?
我知道什么？ I just sell Middle Eastern food from a cart!
我只是用推车卖中东食物！

Amy: Hey, your English is getting better!!
嘿嘿，你的英语越来越好了！！

Ross: (to Joey) Oh my God!
（对乔伊）天啊！

Joey: I know, she may be the hottest girl I've ever hated.
我知道，她可能是我曾经讨厌过的最性感的女孩。

Ross: What...
什么... what you working on?
你在做什么？

Joey: (using a laptop) Oh, Monica and Chandler's recommendation.
（使用笔记本电脑）哦，莫妮卡和钱德勒的推荐。 I want it to sound smart but..
我希望它听起来很聪明，但是.. I don't know any big words or anything, so...
我又不认识什么高深的词，所以……

Ross: Why don't you use your Thesaurus?
你为什么不使用你的同义词库？

Joey: What did I just say?
我刚才说什么了？

Ross: Watch.
看着。 (he takes the laptop) Here, you ehm...
（他拿起笔记本电脑）在这里，你嗯…… You highlight the word you want to change.
您突出显示要更改的单词。
Go under Tools and the Thesaurus generates...
转到“工具”下，同义词库会生成... 'gives'...
‘给予’... 'gives' a whole list of choices.
“给出”完整的选择列表。 You can pick the word that sounds smartest.
您可以选择听起来最聪明的词。

Joey: Oh my God, that's great!
天哪，太棒了！ I'm smart!!
我很聪明！！ No, no, I'm...
不不不，我是... (he uses the Thesaurus) "brainy, bright, clever", I love this thing!
（查同义词）“博学、睿智、聪颖”，我爱死这玩意儿了！ Look out ladies, Joey Tribbiani's got the whole package!!
女士们，当心了，乔伊·崔比安尼现在可是十全十美啦！

 

[Scene: Rachel's room. Rachel is attending to Emma. Amy is standing behind her.]

 

Rachel: God!
上帝！

Amy: So beautiful.
如此美丽。

Rachel: Oh, I know, isn't she?
哦，我知道，不是吗？

Amy: No, I was talking about your bedding.
不，我是在说你的床上用品。

Rachel: All right.
好的。 What's your news, Amy?
艾米，你有什么消息吗？

Amy: Oh!
哦！ Um...
嗯... Well...
这个嘛…… I'm getting married.
我要结婚了。

Rachel: What?
什么？ Oh my God!
我的天啊！ To who?
给谁？

Amy: This guy!
这家伙！ He has a killer apartment.
他有套棒极了的公寓。

Rachel: A-And??
A-还有？

Amy: A-And it's on Fifth.
而且就在第五大道上。 And the elevator opens up right into the living room.
电梯直接通向客厅。

Rachel: No, what's he like?
不，他是什么样的人？

Amy: Oh!
哦！ He's ok.
他没事。 Do you remember my old boyfriend Mark?
你还记得我的前男友马克吗？

Rachel: Yeah.
是的。

Amy: It's his dad.
这是他的父亲。

Rachel: Huh...
呃…… wow, so he's gotta be...
哇，所以他一定是...

Amy: Old?
老的？ Yeah!
是的！ But he travels a lot, so he's hardly ever there.
但他经常出差，所以很少去那里。

Rachel: Sweety, I gotta tell ya...
亲爱的，我得告诉你... it sounds a little bit like you like the apartment more than you like...
听起来有点像你更喜欢这套公寓而不是你喜欢的......

Amy: Myron.
迈伦. Hmm...
唔... I told you he was old!
我告诉过你他老了！

Rachel: Oh...
哦... sit down, sit down.
坐下，坐下。 Oh, honey, you know, I once also almost married somebody that I didn’t love.
哦，亲爱的，你知道吗，我也曾经差点和一个我不爱的人结婚。 Do you remember Barry?
你还记得巴里吗？

Amy: Humpf, remember him?
哼，怎么会不记得他？ How we used to make out all the time after you went to sleep.
过去我们总是在你睡着后亲热。

Rachel: Sometimes just nodding is ok.
有时只是点头就可以了。 (pause) Uhm, so but anyway, listen, not marrying Barry was the best decision that I ever, ever made.
（停顿）嗯，但是无论如何，听着，不嫁给巴里是我做过的最好的决定。 Honey, you deserve true love.
亲爱的，你值得真爱。 Your soulmate is out there, somewhere.
你的灵魂伴侣就在那里，在某个地方。 Someone that is your age, that is smart, that is fun and that you care about!
与你年龄相仿、聪明、有趣并且你关心的人！

Amy: (thinks about it) You’re right, you’re right!
（想了想）你说得对，你说得对！ I’m gonna do it!
我会做的！

Rachel: Ok.
好的。

Amy: I’m gonna marry Myron and keep looking for Mr Right.
我要嫁给迈伦，然后继续寻找真命天子。

Rachel: Ok, let’s keep talking.
好吧，我们继续说。

 

[Scene: Madison Square Garden. Mike and Phoebe are walking to their seats.]

 

Phoebe: Excuse me, anniversary.
对不起，周年纪念日。 Excuse me, anniversary.
对不起，周年纪念日。 (looking at her ticket).
（看着她的票）。 Uhm, sir, could you move your nachos...
呃，先生，你能把你的玉米片移走吗？ they’re in my seat.
他们在我的座位上。 It's my anniversary.
这是我的周年纪念日。 (to Mike) Here we are!
（对迈克）我们到了！ (Mike nods).
（迈克点头）。 Can’t believe it's been a whole year!
不敢相信已经过去一整年了！

Mike: I know.
我知道。 This has been the best year...
这是最好的一年... (the crowd starts cheering so he starts yelling) THIS HAS BEEN THE BEST YEAR OF MY LIFE!
（人群开始欢呼，他开始大喊）这是我一生中最美好的一年！

Phoebe: ME TOO!
我也是！ I NEVER THOUGHT I COULD LOVE SOMEONE THIS MUCH!
我从来没有想过我可以这么爱一个人！

Mike: I FEEL THE SAME WAY!
我也有同样的感觉！

Phoebe: YOU’RE SO GENEROUS AND KIND AND (crowd stops cheering) YOU'RE AMAZING IN BED (everyone hears it and stare at them.) (to everybody) IT’S OUR ANNIVERSARY!
你是如此的慷慨和善良（人群停止欢呼）你在床上的表现太棒了（每个人都听到并盯着他们看。）（对每个人）这是我们的周年纪念日！

Announcer: Knicks fans, please turn your attention to the big screen on the score board.
尼克斯队球迷请把注意力转向计分板上的大屏幕。 Someone has a special question to ask.
有人有一个特殊的问题要问。 (on the screen there’s written ‘Julie, will you marry me?’ and goes on to show a guy kneeling down in front of a girl holding out a ring to her)

Phoebe: Oh how lame...
哎呀，多么蹩脚啊... oh, it’s so tacky, and impersonal.
哦，这太俗气了，而且没有人情味。

Mike: Really?
真的吗？

Phoebe: Oh, it’s the worst way to propose!
哦，这是最糟糕的求婚方式！

Mike: (looks strangely shocked) Excuse me...
（看起来很惊讶）对不起…… (he leaves, then Phoebe realizes what she did).
（他离开了，然后菲比意识到她做了什么）。

 

[Scene: Monica’s apartment. Joey enters the room]

 

Joey: Hey, finished my recommendation.
嘿，我的推荐信写完了。 (he hands it over to Chandler) Here.
（他把它交给钱德勒）这里。 And I think you’ll be very, very happy.
我想你会非常非常高兴。 It’s the longest I ever spent on a computer without looking at porn.
这是我在电脑上不看色情片的时间最长的一次。

Chandler: (reading) I don’t...
（读）我不... uh...
呃... understand.
理解。

Joey: (sounding very proud of himself) Some of the words are a little too sophisticated for ya?
（听起来很自豪）有些话对你来说有点太复杂了？

Monica: (also reading it) It doesn’t make any sense.
（也在读）这没有任何意义。

Joey: Of course it does!
当然可以！ It’s smart!
很聪明！ I used the the-saurus!
我用的是同——义词库！

Chandler: On every word?
每一个字？

Joey: Yep!
是的！

Monica: Alright, what was this sentence originally?
好吧，这句话原本是什么？ (shows the sentence to Joey)

Joey: Oh, ‘They are warm, nice, people with big hearts’.
哦，‘他们是热情、友善、心胸宽广的人’。

Chandler: And that became ‘they are humid prepossessing Homo Sapiens with full sized aortic pumps...?
这就变成了“他们是具有全尺寸主动脉泵的潮湿而迷人的智人……”？

Joey: Yeah, yeah and hey, I really mean it, dude.
是的，是的，嘿，我是认真的，伙计。

Monica: Hey Joey, I don’t think we can use this.
嘿乔伊，我想我们不能用这个。

Joey: Why not?
为什么不呢？

Monica: Well, because you signed it baby kangaroo Tribbiani (Joey makes a 'and-what’s-wrong-with-that' look).
好吧，因为你给它签名的是小袋鼠崔比安尼（乔伊做出“这有什么问题”的表情）。 Hey, why don’t you stop worrying about sounding smart and just be yourself!
嘿，你为什么不停止担心听起来聪明，做你自己！

Chandler: You know what?
你知道吗？ You don’t need a thesaurus, just write from here, (points at his own heart) your full sized aortic pump.
你不需要同义词库，只需从这里开始写，（指着自己的心脏）你的全尺寸主动脉泵。

 

[Scene: The corridor. Amy knocks Joey’s door and Rachel opens the door.]

 

Rachel: Amy, hi!
艾米，嗨！

Amy: I took your advice, I left Myron.
我听从了你的建议，离开了迈伦。

Rachel: Oh, good for you!
真好，干得漂亮！

Amy: I know!
我知道！ I'm Erin Brockovich!
我简直就是《永不妥协》里的艾琳！

Rachel: Yes you are!
是的，你是！ Oh, I am so proud of you!
哦，我真为你感到骄傲！

Amy: Thank you!
谢谢你！ So, can I stay with you?
那么，我可以留在你身边吗？

Rachel: But Erin Brockovich had her own house.
但艾琳·布罗科维奇有自己的房子。

(Joey comes out of Monica’s apartment and sees Rachel and Amy but does not notice the huge amount of bags)

Joey: Ah, look who’s back!
啊，看看谁回来了！ (he sees the bags) Why do you have bags?
（他看到了袋子）你为什么有袋子？ RACH, WHY DOES SHE HAVE BAGS?
瑞秋，她为什么有包？

Amy: Well, I’m staying with you guys!
好吧，我和你们在一起！

Joey: What?
什么？

Amy: We’re gonna be roomies!
我们要成为室友了！ (she snaps her finger and points at Joey, snaps her fingers again and points to the bags) Come on!
（她打响指，指着乔伊，又打响指，指着袋子）来吧！

 

[Scene: Joey’s apartment. Rachel is in the living room and Joey comes out of his room.]

 

Joey: You slept out here?
你睡在这儿吗？

Rachel: Yeah...
是的... Amy kept kicking me in her sleep yelling ‘Myron, get off!’
艾米在睡梦中不停地踢我，大喊“迈伦，滚开！”

Joey: But uhm, we're getting rid of her, right?
但是呃，我们要摆脱她了，对吧？ Rach, please tell me we’re getting rid of her.
瑞秋，请告诉我我们要摆脱她了。

Rachel: Joey, I can’t do that!
乔伊，我不能这么做！

Joey: Oh, come on!
哦，来吧！ Last night I was finishing off a pizza and she said (aping Amy badly) "Uoh oh oh, a moment on the lips, forever on the hips!"
昨晚我正要吃完一个披萨，她说（拙劣地模仿艾米）：“嘴上痛快一时，肥肉跟你一世！” I don’t need that kind of talk in my house!
我不需要在我家里进行这种谈话！

Rachel: Well Joey, uhm look, I know that she’s difficult, but I think it’s really good that she’s here.
好吧，乔伊，嗯，听着，我知道她很难相处，但我认为她在这里真的很好。

Joey: 'Cause we will appreciate it more when she’s gone?
因为她离开后我们会更加感激？

Rachel: No, it's just...
不，这只是... look, you know, when I first moved to the city I was a lot like her!
你看，你知道，当我第一次搬到这座城市时，我很像她！ I was spoiled, self-centered and you guys really took care of me.
我被宠坏了，以自我为中心，而你们真的很照顾我。

Joey: Yeah, Monica made us!
对，是莫妮卡逼我们照顾你的！

Rachel: Well, uhm...
嗯，嗯... whatever, I have really appreciated it, 'cause I don’t think I would be the person that I am today if it wasn’t for you guys.
不管怎样，我真的很感激，因为如果没有你们，我想我不会成为今天的我。 See, I wanna help Amy the way you guys helped me.
看，我想像你们帮助我一样帮助艾米。 And I know it’s gonna take patience, but that’s ok.
我知道这需要耐心，但没关系。

Amy: Good morning.
早上好。

Joey: Yeaah.
是啊。

Rachel: Amy, that’s what I was supposed to wear today, that’s why I hung it on the door.
艾米，这就是我今天应该穿的衣服，所以我把它挂在门上。

Amy: Oh, sweety, you can’t pull this off.
亲爱的，你可穿不出这件衣服的效果。

Rachel: Amy, you know what?
艾米，你知道吗？ I was thinking that maybe now it'd be a good time for us to sit down and, you know, talk about your future.
我在想也许现在是我们坐下来谈谈你的未来的好时机。

Amy: Oh, I can’t, honey.
哦，我不能，亲爱的。 I’m gonna go get my eyebrows shaped.
我要去修眉毛。 (points at her eyebrows) I am not happy.
（指着眉毛）我不高兴。 (to Joey who has a pizza box in his hands) Oh...
（对手里拿着披萨盒的乔伊）哦…… sure you wanna eat that?
确定你想吃那个吗？

Joey: (yelling at her) I’M CURVY, AND I LIKE IT!
（大喊）我就是丰满，我乐意！

 

[Scene: Monica’s Apartment. Rachel, Ross, Monica and Chandler are there, Phoebe enters the room]

 

Phoebe: Hi.

告诉她我们去年的事。

哦，好吧，我给钱德勒买了一块五百美元的手表，他给我写了一首说唱歌曲。

严重地？

没错，哟！

嗯，我的比那更糟糕。

嗯，发生了什么事？

我们在看比赛，这个家伙在大屏幕上向他的女朋友求婚了……

天啊，迈克要求婚了？

菲比，这可是大事啊！

嗯，你想嫁给他吗？

是的，我真的愿意！ Yes, but, after I dumped on the way he was gonna propose to me, I don’t think he’s ever gonna ask again!
是，可我把他原本打算求婚的方式痛批了一顿，他恐怕再也不会开口了！ I mean, I said no in Barbados and now this!
我的意思是，我在巴巴多斯说不，现在这个！

Chandler: She's right!
她是对的！ If I were a guy and...
如果我是个男人并且... (stops himself mid-sentence...everyone stares at him) Did I just say if I were a guy..?
（说到一半就停住了……每个人都盯着他）我刚刚说过如果我是个男人吗……？

我向钱德勒求婚了！ (Phoebe stops herself from laughing) Alright, moving on...
（菲比忍住笑）好吧，继续……

（对瑞秋和罗斯）好吧，你认为我应该求婚吗？

我想这可能会很棒！

绝对地！ You'll love the feeling!
你一定会喜欢这种感觉的！ There's nothing like it!
没有什么比这更好的了！

好吧好吧，那我该怎么办呢？

在大屏幕上看一场比赛怎么样？

Rachel: (Sarcastically) Uuuh!!
（讽刺地）呃呃！！ How about at a Footlocker?
去 Footlocker 怎么样？ (claps her hands together, faking excitement)

Monica: What?
什么？ what?
什么？ He obviously thinks that's a nice way to be proposed to, plus he'd never suspect it!
他显然认为这是一种很好的求婚方式，而且他从来没有怀疑过！

Phoebe: Yeah, that does make sense.
是的，这确实有道理。 Ok, now, would...
好吧，现在，会... would you two (points to Ross and Chandler) like that?
你们两个（指着罗斯和钱德勒）会喜欢吗？

Chandler: Sounds good to me...
对我来说听起来不错... but what would a guy think?
可男人会怎么想呢？

(Amy walks in carrying a phone handset)

Amy: (To Rachel) Nana is on the phone (Hands the phone over to Rachel)
（对瑞秋）娜娜正在打电话（把电话交给瑞秋）

Rachel: (Takes the phone) Oh!
（接过电话）哦！ That's interesting, since she died seven years ago!!
这很有趣，因为她七年前就去世了！

Amy: She did?
她做到了？ Who got her condo in Boca?
她在博卡的公寓归谁了？

Rachel: (Into the phone) Hello?
（对着电话）喂？ (announces to Amy) Oh, it's our nanny!
（向艾米宣布）哦，是我们的保姆！ (goes back to the phone conversation) Hi!
（回到电话交谈）嗨！ Oh...
哦... God!
上帝！ I hope you feel better!
我希望你感觉好多了！ Ok, bye!
好的，再见！ (Hangs up) (To Ross) That's Molly, she's sick.
（挂断）（对罗斯）那是莫莉，她病了。 Can you watch Emma today?
今天可以看艾玛吗？

Ross: No, I can't.
不，我不能。 I have back-to-back classes.
我的课一节接着一节。 Did Molly say what she had?
莫莉说她得的什么病了吗？ Because my throat's been hurting?
因为我喉咙痛？

Rachel: Menstrual cramps.
痛经。

Ross: I don't think that's what this is.
那我应该不是这个毛病。

Rachel: (To Monica, Chandler and Phoebe) Can any of you watch Emma?
（对莫妮卡、钱德勒和菲比）你们有人能看艾玛吗？

Monica: No, sorry sweety..
不，对不起亲爱的..

Phoebe: No, I've got work and then I'm proposing..
不，我还有工作，然后我就求婚了..

Rachel: (To Ross) Great, shoot, what are we gonna do?
（对罗斯）糟了，这下怎么办？

Amy: Well, I can do it.
嗯，我能做到。

Rachel: (Thinks for a moment) Well, actually...
（想了一会儿）嗯，实际上……

Ross: (He interrupts her immediately, and drags her by her arm to the other side of the room) Well, can I talk to you for a sec.?
（他立即打断她，拉着她的手臂把她拖到房间的另一边）好吧，我可以和你聊一会儿吗？

是的。

嗯，我不想让她照顾我们的孩子。

为什么不呢？

好吧，一方面，她一直叫她艾拉！

Rachel: (Defends Amy) Wha..
（为艾米辩护）什么.. well, Ella's a nice name!
嗯，艾拉是个好名字！

好吧，我们就叫下一位为艾拉。

Rachel: (Shocked) Wha...
（震惊）什... the next one?
下一个？

Ross: (a little confused) Okay, um...
（有点困惑）好吧，嗯…… I don't want her watching our baby.
我不想让她看着我们的孩子。

Rachel: Ross, I am trying to help her become a better person.
罗斯，我正在努力帮助她成为一个更好的人。 This is a huge breakthrough for her!
这对她来说是一个巨大的突破！ She just offered to do something for another human being!!
她只是提出为另一个人做点什么！

Ross: I...
我... I don't know..
我不知道..

Rachel: Ross, I'm telling you, she's giving up getting her eyebrows (points at her own to emphasize the word) shaped to do this alright?
罗斯，我告诉你，她放弃了修眉毛（指着自己的眉毛以强调这个词），好吗？ Do you understand how important that is in our world?
你知道这对我们的世界有多重要吗？

(Amy approaches from behind)

Amy: um...
嗯... listen, I couldn't help but overhear...
听着，我忍不住听到了…… 'cause I was trying to...
因为我试图... Listen, let me do this alright?
听着，让我做这个好吗？ I really wanna help you guys out, and plus Rachel's been so wonderful to me...
我真的很想帮助你们，而且瑞秋对我来说太棒了...... (looks at hem pleadingly)

(Rachel looks at Ross and her agrees silently)

Rachel: Absolutely.
绝对地。

Amy: (very excited) Oh!
（很兴奋）哦！ Great!
伟大的！ So how much does it pay?
那给多少工钱？ (Ross just gives up and leaves)

 

[Scene: Central Perk. Joey is inside, Chandler and Monica walk in.]

 

Chandler: Hey Joe!
嘿乔！ How's the second draft of the letter coming?
这封信的第二稿写得怎么样了？

太好了，我完成了！ In fact, I just dropped it off at the agency.
事实上，我刚刚把它交给了代理机构。

(Chandler and Monica look shocked)

Monica: You dropped it off?
你已经交过去了？

Joey: Yeah.
是的。

Chandler: Can we read it?
我们可以读一下吗？ Can you print out another copy?
你能再打印一份吗？

没办法，朋友。 No, I didn't use the computer.
不，我没有使用电脑。 Felt more personal to hand-write it.
手写感觉更个性化。 (Chandler and Monica look even more shocked)

是你手写的吗？

我根本没有试图让自己听起来很聪明！ See ya later!
稍后见！ (Leaves)

天哪，天哪，那封信要进我们的档案了！ We're never gonna get a kid.
我们永远不会有孩子。 No, we're gonna be one of those old couples that collects orchids or has a lot of birds!
不，我们要成为那些收集兰花或养很多鸟的老夫妇之一！

没关系，没关系。 You know what?
你知道吗？ (Takes out his mobile) I'll just call the agency and tell them to throw out the letter.
（拿出手机）我会打电话给该机构并告诉他们扔掉这封信。 (starts dialing)

Monica: Okay good.
好的好的。

Chandler: (on the phone) Hello, this is Chandler Bing.
（电话中）您好，我是钱德勒·宾。 Somebody just dropped off a handwritten recommendation letter, and..
有人刚刚寄来一封手写的推荐信，然后.. (listens) Uh-huh...
（听）嗯嗯…… Uh-huh...
呃呃... okay...
好的... thank you.

再见。 (hangs up looking very confused).
（挂断电话，看起来很困惑）。

呃，我们完蛋了，不是吗？ You know what?

就在去鸟店的路上告诉我吧。

Chandler: (Still looks confused) They loved it.
（仍然看起来很困惑）他们喜欢它。

他们认为我们让孩子写推荐信是非常明智的。

（惊讶）他们以为乔伊是个孩子？

(Amy comes in with Emma in a stroller)

嘿，你们今天做了什么？

听起来很有趣。

(Rachel comes in, sees Amy and Emma)

（对艾玛）嘿！ Hi, how's my girl?
嗨，我的女孩怎么样？

而且，我给你送了一份礼物，因为你让我和你在一起。 Ready?
准备好？

（听起来很兴奋）是啊！

(Amy takes off Emma's hat)

(Rachel looks at Emma)

(Rachel looks very shocked)

COMMERCIAL BREAK


Rachel: You pierced her ears?
你给她打耳洞了？ How could you do this without telling me?
你怎么能不告诉我就这么做呢？

好吧，如果我告诉你，那就不会感到惊讶了，不是吗？

Chandler: I think she looks cute.
我觉得她看起来很可爱。 (Rachel turns around and stares at him angrily) ...
（瑞秋转过身，愤怒地瞪着他）…… but I am wrong!
但我错了！

Rachel: Oh my God, Oh my God, here comes Ross.
天哪，天哪，罗斯来了。 He's gonna flip out.
他会发疯的。

Amy: Why, did something happen to his falafel cart?
为什么，他的沙拉三明治车出了什么事？

Rachel: Ugh.
啊。 (takes the hat and covers Emma's head and half her face with it)

(Ross enters)

Ross: Hey guys.
嘿伙计们。

Monica and Chandler: Hi Ross.
嗨罗斯。

Ross: Hey Emma.
嘿艾玛。 Oh, why is she wearing her hat so low?
哦，她为什么把帽子戴得这么低？ She can barely see.
她几乎看不见。 (Wants to take the hat off, but Rachel tries to stop him).
（想要摘下帽子，但瑞秋试图阻止他）。

Rachel: Nah, I don't really want her to see.
不，我真的不想让她看到。

Ross: Why not?
为什么不呢？

Monica: Because there are so many terrible sights in this world.
因为这个世界上有太多可怕的景象。

Chandler: Like war.
就像战争一样。 Or that thing in Joey's refrigerator.
或者乔伊冰箱里的那个东西。 Remember?
记住？ It was in a milk carton but it looked like meat?
它装在牛奶盒里，但看起来像肉？

Ross: Come here (Removes Emma's hat) Oh!
过来（摘下艾玛的帽子）哦！ There she is!
她在那儿！ Hi!
你好！

(Rachel looks worried)

Ross: (sees how strangely Monica, Chandler and Rachel are looking at him) What?
（看到莫妮卡、钱德勒和瑞秋多么奇怪地看着他）什么？

没有什么。

Ross: (Back to Emma) Hi!
（回到艾玛）嗨！ (Looks at her) What...
（看着她）什么…… (Moves the stroller away from him so he can get a better look at her. He looks at her confused. Finally he realizes the difference and gasps).
（把婴儿车从他身边移开，这样他就可以更好地观察她。他困惑地看着她。最后他意识到了差异，喘了口气）。 Please tell me those are clip-ons.
拜托告诉我，那是不用打耳洞的耳夹。

Rachel: Oh, they're real!
哦，它们是真的！

Ross: Did she (points at Amy) do this to her?
她（指着艾米）对她做了这样的事吗？ I told you we shouldn't have left Emma with her!

我知道，我知道，罗斯你是对的。 (To Amy) You are soo irresponsible I am never letting you baby-sit ever again!
（对艾米）你太不负责任了，我再也不会让你当保姆了！

Amy: Hey you know what, this kid needs me, okay?
嘿你知道吗，这孩子需要我，好吗？ She needs to have a cool fun aunt!
她需要一个又酷又有趣的阿姨！

我是一个又酷又有趣的阿姨！

Amy: (Sarcastically) O-Okay!
（讽刺地）哦，好吧！

Chandler: Hey!
嘿！ Monica can be cool and fun at organized indoor projects!
莫妮卡在有组织的室内项目中可以很酷很有趣！

Amy: Well, I don't need you to help me, because I already know what I'm going to do with my life.
好吧，我不需要你帮助我，因为我已经知道我要做什么了。

从今天开始... I am going to be a baby stylist.

（难以置信地看看罗斯，然后又看看艾米）什么？

根本就没这职业！

嗯，应该是这样。 I'm gonna help babies learn how to accessorize, what colors to wear, what clothes are slimming...
我要帮宝宝们学习如何搭配配饰，穿什么颜色，什么衣服显瘦……

Rachel: (shouting) Babies don't care if they're slim.
（大喊）婴儿不在乎自己是否苗条。

Amy: Enter Amy!
艾米登场！

Ross: (very angry) Amy, I ju...
（非常生气）艾米，我... I just...
我只是... I just wanna...
我只是想...

Amy: What?
什么？ What are you gonna do?
你要做什么？

Ross: (pointing at Amy, shouting) No more falafel for you!
（指着艾米大喊）不再给你沙拉三明治了！

(Amy looks at Ross, angrily. Rachel clearly doesn't understand what he meant and looks at Ross who gestures "later".)

 

[Scene: Madison Square Garden. Phoebe and Mike are watching the game. There's cheering, but Phoebe seems distracted.]

 

Mike: Great game, huh?
比赛不错吧？

Phoebe: Uhuh, uhuh...
呃呃…… (seems distracted)

Mike: Why do you keep looking at the screen?
你为什么一直看着屏幕？

我不是。 I'm praying.
我正在祈祷。 (looking up) Please let the Knicks win...
（抬头）请让尼克斯队获胜…… Thank you Thor!
谢谢托尔！ (Mike is standing up) Where...
（迈克站起来）哪里…… where are you going?
你要去哪里？

Phoebe: Well, I think you should wait.
嗯，我想你应该等待。

为什么？

Phoebe: Well, if you don't...
好吧，如果你不... if you don't hold it in, you don't get all the nutrients.
要是不憋着点，营养就吸收不充分。

Announcer: Knicks fans, please turn your attention to the big screen on the scoreboard.
尼克斯球迷请把注意力转向记分牌大屏幕上。 Someone has a special question to ask.
有人有一个特殊的问题要问。

(We see the screen where it says: "Mike will you marry me?"
“迈克，你愿意嫁给我吗？” and then we see Phoebe and Mike on the screen.
然后我们在屏幕上看到菲比和迈克。 Phoebe stands up and kneels in front of Mike.)
菲比站起来跪在迈克面前。）

Phoebe: Mike Hannigan...
迈克·汉尼根... will you marry me?
你愿意嫁给我吗？ (Mike looks bewildered)

Announcer: Get a load of this...
快瞧瞧…… She's proposing to him.
她正在向他求婚。 Guess we know who wears the pants in that family.
看来大家都知道这家是谁说了算了。 (people are laughing, while Mike still seems bewildered)

Phoebe: That's not very enlightened!
这可不太开明啊！

(There's booing around them, and Mike sinks in his chair, holding his hand in above his eyes, hoping no-one would recognize him)

Phoebe: Hey, hey!
嘿嘿！ (shouting) Boo us?
（大喊）嘘我们？ Boo you!
嘘你！

 

[Scene: Rachel and Joey's. Joey is in the kitchen and the telephone rings.]

 

Joey: (picks up the phone) Hello?
（拿起电话）喂？ Yeah, this is Joey Tribbiani...
是的，这是乔伊·崔比安尼…… Oh, hi!
哦，嗨！ Well, I'm glad you liked my letter...
嗯，我很高兴你喜欢我的信...... No my mommy and daddy aren't home right now...
不，我爸爸妈妈现在不在家... (looks puzzled) Okay, bye bye.
（看起来很困惑）好的，再见。 (hangs up) (to himself) She was nice!
（挂断）（自言自语）她很好！

(Rachel and Amy enter)

Rachel: Joey, get Amy's bags, she is moving out!
乔伊，去拿艾米的包，她要搬走了！

Joey: Whoo-hoo!
呼呼！ (and leaves for Rachel's room)

Amy: You're kicking me out?
你要把我赶出去吗？

Rachel: You put holes in my baby's ears!
你把我宝宝的耳朵打洞了！

（喘息）我不敢相信我曾经试图帮助你。 You are so beyond help.

自从我来到这里，你就一直消极。

Amy: You didn't want me to marry the old guy with the great apartment.
你不想让我嫁给那个拥有豪华公寓的老家伙。 Then, I tried to help your daughter to de-emphasize her flaws (frantically pointing at her nose) And suddenly I am the bad guy?
然后，我试图帮助你女儿淡化她的缺点（疯狂地指着她的鼻子）突然间我就成了坏人？

Rachel: (yelling) Joey, where are those bags?
（大喊）乔伊，那些包在哪里？

Joey: (Yelling from Rachel's room) She has a lot of crap!
（从瑞秋房里大喊）她的破烂可真多！

Amy: You know what?
你知道吗？ When I moved in here I thought: This is gonna be so great.
当我搬到这里时，我想：这会很棒。 Just us sisters, back together again like when we were kids, except without that stupid Jill...
只有我们姐妹，像小时候一样再次聚在一起，除了那个愚蠢的吉尔…… Oh!
哦！ Who has gotten fat by the way...
顺便说一句，她现在胖了……

Rachel: (doesn't believe what she's hearing) Seriously?
（不相信她听到的话）认真的吗？

Amy: hm-mmm...
嗯嗯... Mom said she gained like fifteen pounds.
妈妈说她体重增加了大约十五磅。

Rachel: Hips or thighs?
臀部还是大腿？

Amy: Ass and face.
屁股和脸。

Rachel: (gasps) Oh!
（喘气）哦！ Oh my God!
我的天啊！ I thought she was on Atkins.
我还以为她在用阿特金斯低碳水减肥法呢。

Amy: She was.
她本来是在用。 Carbs found her...
碳水化合物找到了她…… See, this is what I wanted.
看吧，这就是我想要的。 Two sisters, talking about real stuff.
两姐妹，聊的是真事。

Rachel: (embarrassed) Oh, I can give you that.
（尴尬）哦，我可以给你。

Amy: You can?
你可以？

Rachel: Yeah.
是的。 I just, I kept trying to make you a better person, but you're...
我只是，我一直在努力让你成为一个更好的人，但你... you're already a pretty perfect version of what you are.
你已经是一个非常完美的自己了。

Amy: (touched) Thank you.
（感动）谢谢。 I've got to admit, Emma does look cute.
我必须承认，艾玛看起来确实很可爱。

Rachel: Did you just say Emma?
你刚才是说艾玛吗？

Amy: Ugh, I'm sorry...
呃，对不起... Ella.
艾拉。

[Scene: Mike and Phoebe at a restaurant.]

 

Phoebe: That woman at the game didn't know what she was talking about.
比赛中的那个女人不知道自己在说什么。 Mike, obviously you have balls.
迈克，显然你很有胆量。

Mike: But please, let's just forget the whole thing.
但拜托，让我们忘记整件事吧。

Phoebe: (the waiter puts a piece of cake on the table) I would love it.
（服务员把一块蛋糕放在桌子上）我会喜欢的。 Consider it forgotten...
就当这事没发生过吧…… But just so you know...
但只是让你知道... however and whenever you decide to propose, I promise I'll say yes.
不管你决定怎么求婚、什么时候求婚，我保证都会答应。 Whether...
无论... whether, you know, it is in a basketball game, or in sky writing, or you know, like some lame guy in a cheesy movie who hides it in the cake.
不管是在篮球赛场，用飞机在天上写字，还是像俗套爱情电影里的傻瓜一样，把戒指藏在蛋糕里。

(Mike's face changes from happy to sad, and he looks at the cake, disappointed.)

Phoebe: It's in the cake, isn't it?
它在蛋糕里，不是吗？

Mike: (puts on a fake smile) Where else would lame Mr. No Balls hide it?
（强笑）“没种的傻瓜先生”还能藏在哪儿呢？ (he takes the ring from the cake, and cleans it with a napkin)

Phoebe: What's the matter with me?
我怎么了？ How do I keep ruining this?
我如何继续破坏这个？ I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
对不起，对不起！

Mike: No!
不！ It's my fault.
这是我的错。 I keep trying to propose in these stupid ways and all I wanna do is tell you that I love you and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.
我一直试图用这些愚蠢的方式求婚，而我想做的就是告诉你我爱你，我想和你共度余生。

(Phoebe has this weird, anxious, nervous look on her face)

Mike: I'm gonna do this now.
我现在要做这个。

Phoebe: Oh my God!
我的天啊！

(Mike starts to kneel in front of Phoebe.)

Mike: Phoebe, I...
菲比，我...

Phoebe: Wait!
等待！ Oh wait!
哦等等！ (she takes off a ring that was already on her left ring finger. After that Mike starts to kneel again, but then...) Oh no!
（她摘下左手无名指上的戒指。之后迈克又开始跪下，但随后……）哦不！ (She was wearing rings on all her fingers and her thumb, and takes all of these off.)

Mike: Ready?
准备好？

Phoebe: Uh-huh!
嗯嗯！ (and now Mike kneels properly)

Mike: Phoebe, I love you.
菲比，我爱你。 There's no-one else in the world I would ask to marry me...
这世上，除了你，我不会对任何人求婚…… three times.
三次。 But I wanna take care of you, have babies with you, and grow old with you...
但我想陪你，陪你生孩子，陪你变老…… Phoebe Buffay, will you marry me?
菲比布菲，你愿意嫁给我吗？

Phoebe: Yes!
是的！

(Mike puts the ring on her finger)

Mike: I love you!
我爱你！

Phoebe: I love you more!
我更爱你！

Mike: Not possible!
不可能！ (they kiss, and then Mike says proudly...) She's gonna be Mrs. No Balls.
（吻后，迈克自豪地说）她就要成为“没种先生”的太太了。

(They kiss again, and Phoebe looks at the ring.)

COMMERCIAL BREAK

 

[Scene: The street in front of Central Perk. Rachel and Amy are walking on the sidewalk.]

 

Rachel: So how is the uhm...
那么，嗯……怎么样？ baby styling business going?
婴儿造型生意怎么办？

Amy: Not that great.
没那么好。 It's almost if people don't want to hear that their babies are ugly.
人们几乎不想听到他们的孩子很丑。

Rachel: That's shocking!
太令人震惊了！

Amy: Oh!
哦！ It's Ross...
这是罗斯... Hey Ross!
嘿罗斯！ (She says hey to the guy at the falafel stand, whose only similarity with Ross would be his black hair.) Hello-oo Ross!
（她向沙拉三明治摊位上的那个家伙打招呼，他与罗斯唯一的相似之处就是他的黑头发。） 你好罗斯！ (to Rachel) He's rude!
（对瑞秋）他很粗鲁！

THE END
